description: This file provides utility methods for manipulating operand-related types within TensorFlow's Java API, specifically converting lists of Operands to arrays of Outputs, aiding in building operations.

classes.name: Operands
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for operand manipulations. It includes a method to convert a list of Operands into an array of Outputs.

methods.name: asOutputs
methods.description: Converts an iterable of Operand objects into an array of Output objects, facilitating the creation of operation inputs for TensorFlow's Java API.
